products.product_description: Aonic Complete Hers. Dosage: Single serving liquid dietary supplement drink shot, 34 ml (1.1 Fl oz) in plastic bottle, induction sealed closed with plastic lid. Each bottle is a serving intended to be taken orally as a dietary supplement. Shipping unit: two 15 count decorated boxes in a corrugated Aonic Master Shipper. Firm Name and Address on Label: Aonic Inc. 2261 MarketStreet #5416 San Francisco, CA 94114 USA.
